name: Birgit Sippel - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1232 as regards the extension of its period of application
part_text:
The European Parliament has rejected the Commission's proposal to extend the period of application of Regulation (EU) 2021/1232. This regulation sets temporary rules allowing certain online companies to scan messages and other content for child sexual abuse material. The Parliament is asking the Commission to withdraw its proposal entirely. So nothing changes for now — the Parliament has simply said no to keeping these rules running longer, and the Commission must decide what to do next.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament rejected the plan to extend the rules and asked the Commission to withdraw it.
- **Who it affects:** Online messaging and email services, and their users, under the current temporary rules.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must respond to Parliament's request to withdraw its proposal.
